title: [AutoPulse V1] Connect Check-up and Drive to the standard OBD session
body:
Problem: component-level engine results do not establish that both mobile actions use the selected engine. Coordinate with the existing integration writer; do not create a competing implementation.

Scope: trace the current Check-up and Drive controls through connection, standard Mode 01, VIN and classic DTC 03/07/0A, report saving, recovery and Stop. Determine the original polling-to-DTC ordering before changing it. Preserve the existing UI timer owner and state identity. No DTC clearing.

Acceptance: exact source and artifact pins; real-entry replay for both actions including healthy zero-DTC and positive saved DTC/VIN inputs; disconnect/Stop tests show zero TX after completed Stop; reports persist available data and distinguish partial results. Treat phone/stand acceptance separately from host tests.

title: [AutoPulse V1] Verify clone-adapter reset and protocol initialization
body:
Investigation: identify a reproducible ATZ/ATSP failure from existing low-cost ELM327 traces before changing code. Do not assume every missing prompt or byte is garbage.

Scope: existing initialization owner and its callbacks, ordering, timing, parser boundaries and recovery. Do not add speculative sanitizers, sleeps or alternate initialization paths.

Acceptance: preserve exact failing RX/TX input and a healthy CAN neighbour; fix must turn the failing case green without altering the healthy trace or expected oracle. Verify reconnect and Stop cancellation. If no defect reproduces, report NO CHANGE NEEDED with evidence.

title: [AutoPulse V1] Verify fragmented BLE notifications and reconnect boundaries
body:
Investigation: verify the actual BLE receive owner before adding buffering. BLE notification fragmentation and ISO-TP framing are different layers; preserve their existing ownership.

Scope: received notifications through command response assembly, split VIN responses, CR and prompt boundaries, subscription rebind and close races. Do not use cached values or write echoes as received data.

Acceptance: existing fragmented and adjacent-notification fixtures remain green, including no stale first value; a reproduced loss has a frozen FAIL_TO_PASS case and healthy neighbour. Verify no callbacks or TX after completed Stop. No claims about a specific chipset without adapter evidence.

title: [AutoPulse V1] Verify ResponsePending lifecycle on delayed links
body:
Investigation: inspect the existing NRC 0x78 owner and replay tests before changing timeouts. Do not label a timeout as a defect without the corresponding command and receive sequence.

Scope: repeated pending responses followed by completion, timeout, disconnect and Stop; preserve original callback and queue semantics.

Acceptance: pinned reproduced failing sequence plus healthy no-pending neighbour if a fix is needed; final response delivered once; no leaked callback or TX after completed Stop; unchanged healthy ordering and time policy. OEM workflow work remains deferred until standard V1.

title: [AutoPulse V1] Measure adapter-specific sensor coverage and session endurance
body:
Scope: measure the actual selected standard-OBD engine through the Check-up and Drive entry points using existing recorded inputs and the adapter stand. Do not request a new live BMW recording.

Acceptance: establish comparable old/new baselines per adapter and source/artifact SHA. Distinguish supported, received, decoded, fresh and saved sensors. Cover the requested 60-second Check-up and five-minute Drive auto-stop with persistence, disconnect and cancellation cases. Record unsupported sensors and any reduced coverage rather than promising 30-50 readings universally. Host/replay and physical evidence are separate results.

title: [AutoPulse English] Localize the complete user journey and locale fallback
body:
Scope: inventory hardcoded visible strings, diagnostics, authentication errors, report text, plurals, dates and permissions before editing. The supplied app_en.arb is a starter dictionary, not complete coverage. Use one localization owner; Russian language preferences select Russian, all others fall back to en_US. Preserve behaviour and error identifiers. Coordinate with the current UI writer and split oversized files mechanically before behavioural edits as required by repository rules.

Acceptance: generated ARB resources have matching keys/placeholders; locale oracles cover ru_RU, ru_BY, en_US, de_DE and a preference list with Russian. Widget checks cover connection, both diagnostic modes, results, history, profile/auth and errors. No residual Russian UI on the English journey. Existing release gate passes.

title: [AutoPulse Android] Produce traceable signed App Bundle and APK
body:
Prerequisites: English journey accepted, current source frozen and clean, original signing configuration restored by the owner. Never replace the upload key or sign a store release with a debug key.

Scope: extend the existing release build owner for the actual v3 flavor and lib/main_v3.dart entry point; include APP_SOURCE_SHA in both outputs.

Acceptance: existing release gate passes once on the frozen source; signed AAB and APK build successfully; certificate fingerprint matches android/signing_metadata.json; record hashes, source SHA, version and validation results. Store upload/release is a separate explicitly authorized action. A successful build alone is not hardware or release acceptance.

title: [AutoPulse post-V1] Audit existing OEM catalog integration before expansion
body:
Deferred: the current product plan freezes OEM work until standard-OBD V1 acceptance. This issue is not ready for execution.

When unblocked: inspect existing BMW/Mini, Hyundai/Kia, Toyota/Lexus, Ford and Mitsubishi bindings rather than adding a duplicate factory. Preserve identical(driver.scan, scan), constructor side effects such as 7D2 and session header ordering. Establish completeness of translation resources using source evidence.

Acceptance: same-entry positive VIN/DTC and healthy-zero cases using real saved input, correct state identity and constructor side effects, full required translations and independent review on the exact source. Do not infer physical multi-brand compatibility from synthetic fixtures.
